name: version-support-table
title: Version support table
description: Which versions you still support: release date, end of active support, end of life and a status in words, with the next change flagged.
docs: Pass versions with a name, an ISO released date, activeUntil and securityUntil, and optionally a status (current, supported, security-only or end-of-life) and a notesHref. Without a status it is worked out from the dates; Current is always your call. A date that has passed says Ended, and the one date across the table that will change a status next is flagged where it sits, so colour is never the only signal. Dates are written year first by default (dateFormat iso) and sit in time elements; dateFormat medium writes them with locale. Pass a fixed today for stable rendering and tests; without it the current day in timeZone is used. Below 768px each version becomes a card that keeps every label. note sits under the table for what active support and security fixes mean. Pass linkAs={Link} to route the release-notes links.
